mapper.sql:
WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer AND r.status_cd = #{statusCd} AND r.area_cd = #{areaCd} AND r.region LIKE '%' || #{region} || '%' AND r.title LIKE '%' || #{filterKeyword} || '%'
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_user_block ub WHERE ub.user_id = #{viewerId} AND ub.blocked_id = r.reg_id)
mapper.select:
SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.capacity, r.area_cd, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, r.view_cnt, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, ac.code_nm AS area_nm, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN #{viewerId}::text IS NOT NULL AND r.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' LEFT JOIN t_code ac ON ac.code_id = r.area_cd AND ac.p_code_id = 'AREA00'
ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.capacity, r.area_cd, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, ac.code_nm AS area_nm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' LEFT JOIN t_code ac ON ac.code_id = r.area_cd AND ac.p_code_id = 'AREA00' WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.reg_id = #{regId} ORDER BY r.recruit_id DESC

SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS row_id, r.hobby_id, r.title, r.content, r.capacity, r.area_cd, r.region, r.meet_dt, r.status_cd, r.view_cnt, r.reg_id, ho.hobby_nm, sc.code_nm AS status_nm, ac.code_nm AS area_nm, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (CASE WHEN #{viewerId}::text IS NOT NULL AND r.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = r.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y') AS apply_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02') AS accepted_cnt, TO_CHAR(r.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit r LEFT JOIN t_hobby ho ON ho.hobby_id = r.hobby_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = r.status_cd AND sc.p_code_id = 'RECRUIT00' LEFT JOIN t_code ac ON ac.code_id = r.area_cd AND ac.p_code_id = 'AREA00' WHERE r.recruit_id = #{rowId}::integer AND r.use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_recruit (hobby_id, title, content, capacity, area_cd, region, meet_dt, status_cd, view_cnt, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{hobbyId}::integer, #{title}, #{content}, NULLIF(#{capacity}, '')::integer, NULLIF(#{areaCd}, ''), NULLIF(#{region}, ''), NULLIF(#{meetDt}, ''), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{statusCd}, ''), 'RECRUIT01'), 0, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, capacity = NULLIF(#{capacity}, '')::integer, area_cd = NULLIF(#{areaCd}, ''), region = NULLIF(#{region}, ''), meet_dt = NULLIF(#{meetDt}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET status_cd = #{statusCd}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET view_cnt = COALESCE(view_cnt, 0) + 1 WHERE recruit_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE recruit_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT uh.user_id FROM t_user_hobby uh JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = uh.user_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.status_cd = 'STATUS01' WHERE uh.use_yn = 'Y' AND uh.hobby_id = #{hobbyId}::integer AND uh.user_id <> #{hostId}

SELECT a.user_id FROM t_recruit_apply a JOIN t_user u ON u.user_id = a.user_id AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.status_cd = 'STATUS01' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02' AND a.user_id <> #{userId}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit r WHERE r.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND r.use_yn = 'Y' AND (r.reg_id = #{userId} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t_recruit_apply a WHERE a.recruit_id = r.recruit_id AND a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.apply_status = 'APPLY02'))

SELECT c.chat_id::TEXT AS row_id, c.recruit_id, c.content, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = c.reg_id) AS reg_nm, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = c.reg_id) AS reg_handle, (SELECT u.profile_file_id FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = c.reg_id) AS reg_profile_file_id, (CASE WHEN c.reg_id = #{viewerId} THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS mine_yn, (CASE WHEN c.reg_id = (SELECT r.reg_id FROM t_recruit r WHERE r.recruit_id = c.recruit_id) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END) AS host_yn, TO_CHAR(c.reg_dt, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit_chat c WHERE c.use_yn = 'Y' AND c.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer ORDER BY c.chat_id LIMIT 300
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_recruit_chat (recruit_id, content, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{recruitId}::integer, #{content}, 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.select: SELECT chat_id::TEXT AS row_id, recruit_id, content, reg_id FROM t_recruit_chat WHERE chat_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit_chat SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE chat_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT r.recruit_id::TEXT AS "recruitId", r.title AS "title", r.meet_dt AS "meetDt", t.user_id AS "userId" FROM t_recruit r JOIN ( SELECT recruit_id, reg_id AS user_id FROM t_recruit WHERE use_yn = 'Y' UNION SELECT recruit_id, user_id FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND apply_status = 'APPLY02' ) t ON t.recruit_id = r.recruit_id WHERE r.use_yn = 'Y' AND r.meet_dt = #{targetDt} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_notification n WHERE n.user_id = t.user_id AND n.noti_type = 'REMIND' AND n.link_url = '/gen/recruit/' || r.recruit_id AND n.reg_dt::date = CURRENT_DATE ) ORDER BY r.recruit_id, t.user_id

SELECT a.apply_id::TEXT AS row_id, a.recruit_id, a.user_id, a.apply_status, a.apply_memo, a.reg_id, a.attend_cd, (SELECT u.nickname FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.user_id) AS nickname, (SELECT u.handle FROM t_user u WHERE u.user_id = a.user_id) AS user_handle, sc.code_nm AS apply_status_nm, atc.code_nm AS attend_nm,
(CASE WHEN a.apply_status = 'APPLY01' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply w WHERE w.use_yn = 'Y' AND w.recruit_id = a.recruit_id AND w.apply_status = 'APPLY01' AND w.apply_id <= a.apply_id) END) AS wait_no, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit_apply a LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = a.apply_status AND sc.p_code_id = 'APPLY00' LEFT JOIN t_code atc ON atc.code_id = a.attend_cd AND atc.p_code_id = 'ATTEND00' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer ORDER BY a.apply_id

SELECT a.apply_id::TEXT AS row_id, a.recruit_id, a.apply_status, a.apply_memo, r.title AS recruit_title, r.meet_dt, r.region, r.status_cd AS recruit_status_cd, sc.code_nm AS apply_status_nm,
(CASE WHEN a.apply_status = 'APPLY01' THEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply w WHERE w.use_yn = 'Y' AND w.recruit_id = a.recruit_id AND w.apply_status = 'APPLY01' AND w.apply_id <= a.apply_id) END) AS wait_no, TO_CHAR(a.reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_recruit_apply a JOIN t_recruit r ON r.recruit_id = a.recruit_id LEFT JOIN t_code sc ON sc.code_id = a.apply_status AND sc.p_code_id = 'APPLY00' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND a.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY a.apply_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET attend_cd = NULLIF(#{attendCd}, ''), upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE apply_id = #{rowId}::integer
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attend_cd = 'ATTEND01')::TEXT AS "attendedCnt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attend_cd = 'ATTEND02')::TEXT AS "absentCnt", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE attend_cd = 'ATTEND03')::TEXT AS "noshowCnt" FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} AND attend_cd IS NOT NULL
SELECT apply_id::TEXT AS row_id, recruit_id, user_id, apply_status FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE apply_id = #{rowId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_recruit_apply WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_recruit_apply (recruit_id, user_id, apply_status, apply_memo, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{recruitId}::integer, #{userId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{applyStatus}, ''), 'APPLY01'), NULLIF(#{applyMemo}, ''), 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET apply_status = #{applyStatus}, upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE apply_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET use_yn = 'N', upd_id = #{updId}, upd_dt = NOW(), upd_ip = #{updIp} WHERE apply_id = #{rowId}::integer
UPDATE t_recruit_apply SET use_yn = 'N', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE recruit_id = #{recruitId}::integer AND use_yn = 'Y'
